content.rendered:
Rolando Masís-Obando is a PhD candidate of Computational Neuroscience at Princeton University. Scientifically, he is interested in how contexts (like those in VR/AR) shape the way we think and remember our day-to-day experiences. He has scanned dozens of people’s brains (and effectively read their minds) to further understand how the brain represents spaces and concepts. Given the intersection of AR/VR with neuroscience, Rolando’s recent interests revolve around how we can shape a future internet to be more human-centered and grounded under ethical principles. He recently directed a cinematic educational video on the history of the Metaverse and its ongoing issues with privacy and agency. The video can be found here: https://youtu.be/wsJF1ugsfKI

Rolando graduated from Yale University with a focus on Molecular, Cellular and Developmental Biology. During his studies co-founded Shuflix with his brothers, the largest activity search engine (at the time), to help people interact with their environment in a playful alternative way while helping small businesses get more exposure. Since then, he has also co-founded PhDx, a platform to help incoming PhD students with guides and insider knowledge of the unspoken rules in academia.

In his free time, Rolando is a filmmaker, composes for films, creates augmented reality tutorials for his YouTube channel, and does pro-bono marketing consulting for personal brands and small businesses.

content.rendered: Winslow Porter is an award-winning director, producer and creative technologist specializing in virtual/augmented reality as well as large-scale immersive installations. Winslow formed the pioneering, new media studio the New Reality Company in 2016, creating the critically-acclaimed cinematic VR experiences Giant and Tree. Shortly after, he was named Adweek’s Top 100 creatives as digital innovators and a designer-in-residence at A/D/O. In 2018, Tree won the Lumiere for Best Location Based VR Short as well as 7 other notable awards after being shown at over 100 notable conferences and festivals such as TED, UN General Assembly, Davos and Gardens By The Bay. He is currently a Cultural Leader at the World Economic Forum, a mentor in residence at the New Museum Incubator, an adjunct NYU Tisch professor, a founding member of the Onassis Institute’s ONX art/tech accelerator, as well as a creative director and creative tech consultant at R/GA Global. Winslow’s new immersive AR experience Rainforest, which received an Epic Games MegaGrant, transforms participant’s settings into their own private jungle environment to elucidate pressing concepts and concerns of sustainability and conservation. Winslow is also an artist in residence at the Smallhold Mushroom farm in Brooklyn, creating Forager, an immersive experience of the life-cycle of a mushroom, featuring the first volumetric time-lapse inside a game engine.

content.rendered:
Val Vacante is an award-winning global innovator; as the VP of Solutions Innovation at Dentsu, she uncovers cultural trends, commerce dynamics and emerging technologies to shape next-generation product innovations, and solutions impacting the way people connect and experience in the physical and digital world.

Val is the visionary and co-creator behind ShopNXT™ — dentsu’s award-winning patent-pending retail innovations named “top product picks,” at CES by PCR Magazine, “top tools shaping the future of retail” by Adweek, featured in CNET, The Drum, PSFK Retail Innovation Week, eMarketer, MediaPost, PCR, TechAcute among others.

Additionally, Val architected and launched NXT Intelligence™ an innovation platform featuring 12 technology, innovation, and brand solutions designed to rapidly explore, evaluate and evolve business growth opportunities. Her latest work focuses on connected experiences, the evolution of the metaverse, mixed worlds, gaming, retail and play.

She is also the founder of Collabsco where she pioneered the first connected play landscape, mapping 260+ emerging technologies and connected experiences featured in VentureBeat, The Drum, and VRScout.

Her portfolio includes over 50+ brands: Hasbro, Mattel, Disney, Bandai Namco Entertainment, WowWee, AT&T, Vodafone, Nestlé, Mercedes-Benz, MINI, Honeywell, Sleep Number, Dell, MERGE, Virsix Games, among others.

Val has recently been named one of the Top 25 Women in Tech by PCR magazine, The Most Powerful Women in Technology, 2022 by CIO Views and 40 Over Forty.

She serves on the Fast Company Executive Board, SXSW Innovation Advisory Board, is a Global Expert to MassChallenge, an international speaker and writer.

He is passionate about the intersection of web3 and XR, especially when it comes to on-chain identity management, monetization and in-game digital assets.

content.rendered:
Mr. Gappelberg is an accomplished entrepreneur with an expertise in creating, funding and running start-ups, as well as extensive experience both as a hands-on operating executive and as a public markets professional.

From 2000 to 2005, Mr. Gappelberg was the co-founder and CEO of EG Products where he funded, patented, imported and distributed the market’s first LED light-up toy. He secured license deals from Disney, Universal Studios, Clear Channel Communication and built a national sales channel, setting the foundation to land contracts with Walgreen\’s, Macy’s, and live event shows like Ringling Bros.

He was also co-founder and CEO of an app development company which created and published over 200 successful apps for both Apples iTunes store and the Google Play store. Prior to being a successful entrepreneur, Mr. Gappelberg worked on Wall Street and has more than 20 years of extensive experience as both a hedge fund manager and Senior Vice President of Finance.

In 2018, he founded Nextech AR Solutions and is the current CEO of the Company.

meta.resources: Nextech AR Solutions is the engine accelerating the growth of the Metaverse. Using breakthrough AI, Nextech AR is able to quickly, easily, and affordably ARitize (transform) vast quantities and varieties of existing assets at scale making products, people and places ready for interactive 3D use, giving creators at every level all the essential tools they need to build out their digital AR vision in the Metaverse. Our platform agnostic tools allow brands, educators, students, manufacturers, creators, and technologists to create immersive, interactive and the most photo-realistic 3D assets and digital environments, compose AR experiences, and publish them omnichannel. With a full suite of end-to-end AR solutions in 3D Commerce, Education, Events, and Industrial Manufacturing, Nextech AR is in a unique position to meet the needs of the world’s biggest brands and all Metaverse contributors. To learn more, please visit https://www.nextechar.com/

content.rendered: I am an Assistant Professor in the College of Education, at the University of Florida and have experience of developing technologies with autistic, and underserved groups, which started in my undergraduate work exploring multimedia programs for a deaf community in the U.K. I am currently interested in examining and developing the role that VR HMDs can play in supporting young people with autism in their daily lives; informed by their input. The aim of my work is to co-design the future of this field (VR and autism) with autistic communities and other important stakeholders. More than this, I am also interested in developing a range of innovative technologies that can help to enable people with neuro-diversity.

content.rendered:
Dr. Stylianos Mystakidis is a Learning Innovator and Researcher at the University of Patras, Greece, as well as Professor-Counselor at the Hellenic Open University, Greece. His areas of professional expertise and research are Learning Innovation, Metaverse, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Gamification, Serious Games, Open Education and Continuous Professional Development. He has published over 60 articles in peer-reviewed international journals, conference proceedings and books on the previous topics.

He has extensive teaching experience in European (Spain, United Kingdom, Greece, Cyprus) and US universities. In 2020, he co-designed and developed as lead author the official 2-ECTS blended learning course for all educators of Cyprus on “Augmented and Virtual Reality in Teaching and Learning”. He has also designed, developed and managed an innovative, awarded-winning MOOC using playful design and Multiuser Virtual Worlds. He has participated as certified project manager (PMP) and researcher in eleven international projects.

His formal studies include a Ph.D. at the Faculty of Information Technology, University of Jyväskylä (Finland), a MA in Education in Virtual Worlds at the University of West of England Bristol (United Kingdom), a MSc in Mechanical Engineering at the National Technical University of Athens (Greece) and a Postgraduate Certificate at the Open University of Catalonia (Spain).
List of publications: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Stylianos-Mystakidis

As the Coordination and Engagement Team lead for XR Access, he helps organizations invested in XR stay up-to-date on the latest accessibility guidelines and helps find solutions to novel accessibility challenges. He also conducts ongoing research at UC Berkeley on how AR can be used to help people with visual impairments.

content.rendered: Peta is an experienced teacher, researcher and award-winning digital designer specialising in immersive technologies. She designed Pangaea Minds, an educational framework using virtual worlds to connect schools for global team-teaching and student collaboration. Peta has recently led the design of VR and AR solutions for NSW Transport and the Music Performance Industry. Her research in Immersive Design at UNSW was a catalyst for her strong interest in ethics, regulation, and governance specific to the metaverse. She is the Director of XR Global Citizenship and Education at XRSI.org and is currently studying Cyber Law at Deakin University. As a classroom teacher, she is committed to empowering teachers, parents, and students in their understanding of the opportunities, challenges, and risks associated with belonging to virtual worlds and the metaverse. Peta is also winner of the 2021 Immersive Learning Research Network: Best Immersive Learning Project. Pangaea Minds is a truly innovative and global approach to equip students with the attitude and aptitude for conquering the serious economic, political, health, and climate challenges our current leaders are grappling with.

content.rendered:
Jon Gress
CEO
The Metaverse Construction Company LLC

With over 30 years of experience in motion picture, visual effects, immersive media technologies, production and education, Jon Gress has been on the cutting edge of digital production technologies since their inceptions and has done research, development, consulting and training for VFX, Immersive,
Real-time, 3D, CGI, 360 Degree, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Stereoscopic 3D,
Photogrammetry, Dense Mapping, 3D Scanning, 3D Printing, Motion Tracking, Motion Control, Motion Capture, Live Action/Real-Time Animation, Game Engine VFX Integration for Motion Pictures, TV, Internet Media, Marketing & Advertising, Communications and Education.

The Metaverse Construction Company LLC provides clients with turn-key, next-gen, fully immersive, real-time virtual environments for multi-user events, meetings, trainings, showrooms, enterprise, education, entertainment and other Metaverse experiences.

Jon has trained thousands of filmmakers and visual effects artists from all over the world, who have gone on from his training to secure jobs in top visual effects companies and have worked on blockbuster movies and award winning television series including:

24, 47 Ronin, Almost Human, Ant Man, Assassin’s Creed, Captain America, Conan The Barbarian, CSI, Die Hard, Dredd, Fringe, Game of Thrones, GI Joe, Godzilla, Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters, Harry Potter, Hawaii Five-O, Hugo, Iron Man, James Bond, John Carter, Life of Pi, Lost, MIB 3, Mirror Mirror, Narnia,
Need for Speed, Oblivion, Olympus Has Fallen, Oz, Pacific Rim, Pirates of the Caribbean, Riddick, RIPD, Serenity, Snow White and the Huntsman, Spiderman, Stolen, Superman, Star Trek, Star Wars, Terra Nova, The Avengers, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button, The Expendables, The Fast and the Furious,
The Great Gatsby, The Green Hornet, The Green Lantern, The Hobbit, The Hulk, The Hunger Games, The Mechanic, The Twilight Saga, The Walking Dead, The Wolf of Wall Street, Thor, Titanic, Total Recall, Transformers, White House Down, Wolverine, X-Men, and many many more). ( <—feel free to pare this list down, this was what was on my Author bio) Jon is a member of The Visual Effects Society (a global professional honorary society and the entertainment industry’s only organization representing the full breadth of visual effects practitioners with over 4,000 members in more than 40 countries worldwide), co-chair for the global VRARA Universities & Colleges Committee, member of the Virtual Worlds Society and Themed Entertainments Association, a published Pearson Higher Education author (“Digital Visual Effects & Compositing”, the complete college curriculum textbook & instructor’s guide used in colleges all over the world), has been a regular writer/columnist for motion picture industry trade publications and has produced, been a keynote speaker & evangelist for motion picture visual effects and immersive production technologies, directed and supervised hundreds of motion picture, television, VFX and cutting edge interactive multimedia & immersive productions (for institutions ranging from small independent to Fortune 100) since 1995. Jon was previously the Academic Director for The Digital Animation & Visual Effects School at Universal Studios, Orlando FL bringing them decades of expertise, research and development in cutting edge motion picture visual effects, real-time, immersive, and visualization technologies such as 3D Stereoscopic Imaging, 3D Photogrammetry, 360 & 180 VR photo/video, 3D motion tracking, capture & motion control, the integration of these into real-time visualization, VR, AR, MxR & Virtual Production development for Motion Pictures, Games, 3D Visual Effects and Fully Immersive Virtual Environments.

content.rendered:
ANDREW MACDONALD
A serial innovator throughout his filmmaking career, Andrew has always been the first to bring a new camera or technology to set. This led him to co-found Cream’s digital department with Cream CEO David Brady in 2015. This venture has grown from one person incubator to an award-winning full XR production department. Cream has created over 20 pieces of original XR content including 360 3D series, AR apps, and interactive volumetric VR, for networks, studios, agencies, and brands all over the world. Many of these pieces have been invited to show at festivals including Cannes, Sundance, and SXSW. Andrew’s piece “A Curious Mind” won a W3 GOLD 2018 award and a (CSA) Canadian Screen Award 2019.
Andrew is also an executive producer on “Dark threads” Featuring Dominc Monaghan, a VR sci fi adventure recently launched on on Steam. Andrew has become well versed in concept definition, interactive UX design, directing motion capture, game development, and innovation of XR production workflows. Andrew is currently directing an applied research machine learning project on digital humans (DDH) at Sheridan’s screen industries research and technology (SIRT) centre. Andrew is listed as an inventor on two international patent applications. Andrew has raised over $3m in investments and grants, and fostered relationships with industry leaders like HTC, Oculus, Dell, Microsoft, and Adobe.

content.rendered: Anne-Marie is an award-winning Event Producer who loves bringing together inspiring people to create incredible connections. She is the Executive Producer of the Immerse Global Summit and Global Event Director for the VR/AR Association. Anne-Marie also serves as an Ambassador for Mission Impact, a Global Leadership Development program focusing on business-critical web3 training, personal growth, and impact for women so that they can accelerate their leadership within the organization and in the world. She is proud to be on the Advisory Board of The Women of the Future, Web3 & Metaverse Book. Anne-Marie loves using the stages at her events to give a platform for voices that need to be heard.

content.rendered: Katitza Rodriguez is EFF’s Policy Director for Global Privacy. She concentrates on comparative policy of global privacy issues, with special emphasis on emerging technology and cross border data flows. Katitza’s work also focuses on cybersecurity and government access to data at the intersection of international human rights law and standards. Katitza also supervises EFF’s growing Latin American team. She was an advisor to the UN Internet Governance Forum (2009-2010). In 2018, CNET named Katitza one of the 20 most influential Latinos in technology in the United States. In 2014, she was also named one of “The heroes in the fight to save the Internet”.

content.rendered:
Briar Prestidge is a serial entrepreneur and CEO of Prestidge Group a leading personal branding, PR and speaker relations agency managing HNWI, C-level executives, technology experts, celebrities, government officials and investors, with offices in Dubai, New York, and London.

A qualified Digital Marketer, Speech-Language Pathologist and Neuro-Linguistic Programming Business Practitioner with an international career for both private and government sectors (originally from a farm in New Zealand), Briar is obsessed with PR, emerging tech, VR/AR and the metaverse, continual learning, business and entrepreneurship.

Prior to establishing Prestidge Group, Briar led communication and digital teams, including executive branding, for many public/ private sector companies, including a government agency rebrand (both digital and comms lead), overseeing all communication touch points, crisis comms strategy, media training for VIPs, and press launch for regional/ international media.

Briar also has a corporate power suit collection BRIAR PRESTIDGE – The Label (www.briarprestidge.com), made from fine wool and cashmere. In 2022, they created their virtual spin-off collection for avatars and dropped NFT suits on leading VR platform, Decentraland, at the World’s First Metaverse Fashion Week.

Briar is also a Strategic Advisor for Scopernia, specialized in preparing companies for a future in Web3, and she sits on the board for the Metaverse Fashion Council.

She was named ‘Top 100 Most Influential’ in the United Arab Emirates, and she has been featured across Entrepreneur, Forbes, OSN, Emirates Women, Marie Claire, Grazia and The National in recognition of her work. In 2022, Briar also received a lot of publicity around her experiment where she spent ’48 hours in the metaverse’ and through her virtual reality world hopping productions.

As a mentor for startups, Briar works with The Founders Institute and one of the world\’s largest entrepreneurial networks, TiE, and she also provides one-on-one and group session consulting.

Briar advocates the role of a healthy body and mind for entrepreneurs and corporate professionals, which is why she wrote the recipe book “Hunger for Success – A recipe book for businesspeople who hate cooking,” to be released in 2022.

When Briar isn’t working or travelling, you can find her at the gym, Pilates or running, spending time with friends (in real life or virtually…), or studying something new.

content.rendered: Brian currently leads the Production Services group at The Mars Agency, which is comprised of a robust team of production design, finishing, retouching, asset management, execution and print production. He has over 20 years of experience in leading executions for some of the largest CPG\’s and retailers in the industry, both from the lense of the agency, as well as the solution provider. Brian also leads the Disruptive Technologies & Innovation group, focusing on Metaverse, NFTs and Augmented Reality experiences and commerce. Brian has been with the agency for the past 2 years and is based out of Atlanta, GA.

Her background is in research, campaigning and strategy in the not-for-profit sector and with brands. She has designed and implemented global social and policy change campaigns for several international organisations, including Amnesty International, on issues such as online safety and freedom of speech.

content.rendered: Event producer, immersive experience designer & music director/artist Celeste Lear is a Los Angeles based XR professional with 2 decades of discipline within the digital entertainment & audio/visual world. She has lead various teams working with DreamlandXR & has worked on ground breaking projects with world renown production crews to turn out consistently well planned & executed futuristic events, including, high tech multi-media installation experiences, video mapping, conferences, immersive festivals & concerts – both physically and in VR in the metaverse. Founder of Boutique Electronique Music, her work is also centered around the most current tech and trends for AV, sound engineering, performance, music curation, music direction and broadcast. She has a special passion for projects around environmental sustainability, human connection & the arts.

content.rendered:
Rupert Deans
Chief Executive and Founder of Plattar

Immersive Reality pioneer Rupert Deans grew up with dyslexia as a child and often questioned why we have so much 2D content in a 3D world. He recognised the enormous potential of 3D & Augmented Reality to solve practical problems and set out to create a tool that would enable anyone to create their own AR experiences with ease. Plattar launched in February 2017, and has worked with Fortune 500 and ASX100 companies including The Warehouse Group, Bailey Nelson, Red Bull, PWC, Air New Zealand, Flight Center, Baby Bunting, Fisher and Paykel, Nespresso, Samsung, Singel, Schneider Electrical, SAAB and Unilever.

content.rendered: D.J. Smith is the Co-Founder and Chief Creative Officer at The Glimpse Group. The Glimpse Group is a platform company for a portfolio of (14) startups focused on the virtual and augmented reality industries. At Glimpse, D.J.’s responsibilities include overseeing the production of all VR and AR content as well leading the effort to locate new subsidiary companies. In addition, D.J. is the organizer of The New York Virtual Reality Meetup (NYVR). NYVR is the (2nd) largest virtual meetup in the world with 6100+ members and is the premiere venue for industry networking and collaboration within New York City.

content.rendered: Kiira is a multi-dimensional director crossing the mediums of theatre, hybrid cinema and virtual reality. VR credits include: Cardboard City which won the Samsung Gear VR contest (2016) and premiered at the NYFF in 2016. For her interactive VR experience Runnin’ starring Reggie Watts, she was the first VR director to film on the Intel Studios volumetric capture stage (Sundance 2019, Jury Award for Interactive at SXSW 2019). Loveseat, (VR Theatre – Venice Film Festival 2019) was performed simultaneously before live and virtual audiences. Her latest VR Theatre production Finding Pandora X featured Broadway actors and was recently performed virtually at the Venice Film Festival 2020. She is the founder of Double Eye Studios which specializes in VR Theatre, live events and virtual production.

content.rendered:
Marco Carvalho is a visionary entrepreneur who creates transformational technologies, products, and immersive experiences by remixing gaming, film, education, work, and play in the physical and digital world.

Marco is the CEO of HeadOffice.Space where he’s co-creating the world’s first metaverse on the moon, designed for the ever-changing way remote teams work, play, learn and engage — building a sense of belonging, fostering a culture of connection, community, creativity, and productivity.
Marco is an Endeavor Entrepreneur (endeavor.org), multi-award-winning creative director, inventor, and co-founder of global brands, products, and companies in the USA, UK, China, and Brazil.

He has driven innovative products and experiences for over eighteen years across immersive content, art, games, technology, education, adventure parks, and global distribution with over ten years focused on developing AR, VR, and voice/sound technologies.

Marco has partnered with leading global technology, entertainment, games, and consumer product companies, including Universal Studios, WarnerBros., Disney, Amazon, Qualcomm, developing businesses, IPs, products & technology globally.

Marco’s work has been featured on the global stage of innovation as a CES Innovation honoree 2019; Cinequest 2020 best VR Roomscale, 2014 Best Educational toy in France (with Bandai) among others, he serves as a mentor and international speaker featured at Amazon, Qualcomm, UKTI, Harvard University, and Berkeley University.

content.rendered:
Bobby Carlton has worked in immersive technology industry since 2016 when he became the Director of VRLearn at the MASIE Center, working with enterprise learning leader Elliott Masie and helping organizations and government agencies understand how AR/VR/XR technology could make people better learners.

In 2017 he joined VRScout as a writer and continued to work with multiple organizations as an XR consultant. He is also on the SXSW XR Pitch Advisory Board.

In 2022, he joined FS Studio to become their XR/VR Content Manager bringing his years of experience to projects in robotics, automation, infrastructure, mechatronics, marketing, and workforce training.

content.rendered:
Gregg is a media entrepreneur, speaker, educator, and business and marketing strategist with experience in extended reality, virtual world events, location-based entertainment, and emerging media and technologies.

Gregg is currently serving as Senior Vice-President of U.S. Operations / Partner, of HOLOGATE, the world’s most successful immersive media company for location-based entertainment with 13,000,000+ players-to-date across 38 countries around the globe; Co-Vice Chair of the Producers Guild of America ‘New Media Council’ (2nd Term); and Partner and Co-Event Director of DreamlandXR. He also an advisory board member of SXSW ‘Pitch’; ‘Kollab’, which supports thousands of LA youth of the Boys and Girls Clubs of America; and the Cal State University Entertainment Alliance (CSUEA). Previously, Gregg was Chief Strategist / Evangelist at ‘Unofficial Cardboard’, the pioneering and leading Google-Certified producer of ‘Google Cardboard VR’.

Gregg’s speaking engagements include the Augmented World Expo (AWE), Consumer Electronic Show (CES), Game Developer’s Conference (GDC); National Association of Broadcasters (NAB); Dubai Game Conference, Comic-Con, WonderCon, IBC Show | Amsterdam, SIGGRAPH, SXSW, Mobile World Congress, VR/AR Global Summit, Amusement Expo/VR Summit, G2E-Global Game Expo, and many others.

content.rendered:
Amanda’s recent endeavors have lead her to join forces with the Web3 powerhouse DAO, XLA, as Director of Events and lead in experiential marketing. XLA’s mission is to democratize wealth building and revenue distribution for IP creators, owners, and holders by empowering them through the power of Web 3.0 based technologies.

She is the visionary behind 150+ innovative technological events of the past decade, providing the leading curated event platforms for groundbreaking artists, film, immersive media, blockchain technologies, space exploration, motion capture innovation, and other emerging technologies now converging and evolving to create experiences and brands into the metaverse.

Amanda Pool is the Founder of Imagine Global Marketing and Imagine Events Services, producing and executing over 150 individual events in technology, film and music over the last 5+ years. Imagine was Agency of Record for the IBC Convention, Europe’s largest media trade show (curating the schedule for the Future Reality Zone); Agency of Record for the Advanced Imaging Society (producing and curating “On the Lot” at Paramount Studios for three consecutive years). Imagine also produced Eveleigh Social House, VR On the Mountain, and The Fly Lounge at Sundance Film Festival and the Lumiere Awards. She has produced events at Coachella, EDC, NAB, CES, Toronto International Film Festival, Festival de Cannes, and many more.

content.rendered: Andy has long had a passion for mixing art with business and cutting-edge technology to help artists create sustainable magic. Most recently he was Chief Product Officer for Hanai World, a phygital entertainment company led by Cirque du Soleil founder Guy Laliberte, bringing the human performance to new forms of XR and LBE experiences. Andy is a founder of Arcturus, a 3D video software company that enables the authoring, editing and streaming of volumetrically captured performances. Prior to Arcturus, Andy was the creator-focused product manager at YouTube responsible for launching monetization, analytics, payments and reporting solutions for YouTube partners. In early 2015 he shifted his focus to creating YouTube’s initial VR content strategy, launching YouTube’s 360 video feature with top creator content, and leading production for the first stereoscopic 360 music videos. Prior to YouTube, Andy was a serial entrepreneur who co-founded, grew and sold 3 media-tech companies after earning his Wharton MBA and Princeton electrical engineering degrees. Andy is also an avid drummer, stage performer, and arts patron: He toured with a jam band in the late 90\’s, was a trained performer in the Blue Man Group in the early 00\’s, and is now an advisor, executive producer or board member to various creator-focused initiatives.

content.rendered: Amany is an Instructional designer, researcher, Voice User Interface designer, author, and teacher trainer. She is currently pursuing her doctoral degree in the Instructional Technology and Media program at Teachers College, Columbia University. She’s co-hosts Metaverse Adventures at the Immersive Learning Research Network. She founded the VirtuaTELL conference at NYS TESOL in 2021 that brings together educators, practitioners, researchers, and passionate enthusiasts to work together to integrate emerging technologies into education. Her research interests include conversational AI, Extended Reality for education, immersive storytelling, intelligent NFTs and decentralized autonomous organizations.

content.rendered: Elizabeth Strickler is the Founding Director of the Creative Industries Blockchain Lab and Director of Media Entrepreneurship at Georgia State University. She teaches media innovation to undergraduate and graduate students and works with major labels and cultural icons to build web3 and blockchain/nft strategies. Her April 2021 TEDx talk is considered canonical viewing for those entering the nft/metaverse space and she presents regularly on the topic. She holds academic positions in both the Business School and the College of Arts and Sciences, where she has received multiple grants to research innovation and XR in education. Her goal is to help others start businesses, tell immersive stories, and build a stronger cultural economy. She believes most people can learn most things and have fun while doing so. Her eclectic interests can be seen in her academic credentials, holding a BA in Philosophy, BS in Computer Science, and an MFA in Digital Filmmaking and Art.

content.rendered: Iliana Oris Valiente, CPA, CA is widely credited for being a trailblazer in the blockchain industry dating back to 2013. She’s advised fortune 500 companies, government leaders, regulators, and startups – often acting as a translator between web2 and web3 worlds. Iliana is a published author and sought-after speaker; has been featured in various print, radio, and television outlets; sits on the board of several prominent organizations; and is passionate about web3 + philanthropy, DAOs, venture investing, and travel. Currently, Iliana is a Managing Director and Canada Innovation Lead at Accenture, working with senior executives and boards of F500 companies to support their strategic transformation journeys, leading multi-disciplinary teams across design, data, and the latest emerging technologies.

content.rendered:
Eve Weston believes in storytelling as a force for positive change. Weston is writer/director of the award-winning world’s first 360VR immersive sitcom, The BizNest (bit.ly/TLCBizNest). She is also a published expert in XR narrative, author of the taxonomy for immersive POV and a professor of VR filmmaking, TV writing and immersive storytelling at top-ranked film schools.
As CEO of Metaverse Talent Group, she provides real people for virtual worlds, connecting businesses of all kinds with experienced individuals who can host, perform, sell, and represent their business in the metaverse. Learn more at www.castingthemetaverse.com.
Weston is co-founder of TheLook.Club, the first searchable database of immersive narrative, which also features a review show. Weston’s speaking engagements include Stanford University, SIGGRAPH and the Academy of Television Arts and Sciences of Emmys fame.
An award-winning journalist, Weston has written about VR for Ms. Magazine and The New York Post. A produced television writer, she’s written and developed for several ABC/Disney channels and shows, including Wizards of Waverly Place – where she wrote and choreographed a viral YouTube sensation for Selena Gomez. Weston is an alumna of Princeton, USC and Goldman Sachs. Follow her at https://medium.com/@eveweston for cutting-edge insights.

content.rendered:
Peabody field builder winner Nonny de la Peña is the program director of ASU’s center for Emerging Media and Narrative, where she leads a best-in-class research and graduate program with a focus on new narratives developed using emerging media technologies in the areas of arts, culture and nonfiction. She comes to the new Los Angeles-based center, a joint undertaking by The Sidney Poitier New American Film School, in the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts, and the Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication, with more than 20 years working as an award-winning writer, director and producer in virtual, augmented and extended reality, film, print and television. As founder and CEO of Emblematic Group, de la Peña uses cutting-edge technologies to tell stories — both fictional and news-based — that create intense, empathic engagement on the part of viewers via immersive virtual, mixed and augmented reality. Her latest breakthrough is Emblematic’s WebVR platform REACH.Love, a no-code toolset that creates scalable distribution in the medium, democratizes content authorship, and empowers new voices to share their stories.

De la Peña has appeared on the cover of the Wall Street Journal Magazine as Technology Innovator of the Year, was inducted into the SXSW Hall of fame in 2022 and was named one of CNET en Español’s 20 most influential Latinos in tech. Often called the “Godmother of Virtual Reality” for her pioneering work using cutting edge technologies to tell important stories, she is also a New America Fellow, a Yale Poynter Media Fellow and a former correspondent for Newsweek. Widely credited with pioneering the genre of immersive journalism, de la Peña was selected by Wired Magazine as a #MakeTechHuman Agent of Change, and Fast Company named her “One of the People Who Made the World More Creative.” She earned a BA in sociology and visual and environmental studies from Harvard University, an MA in online communities from the USC’s Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism, and a PhD in media arts and practice from the USC School of Cinematic Arts.

content.rendered: Tim is CTO and Co-Founder of MOD Tech Labs. He leads the company to create the groundbreaking AI-powered technology that is reshaping the future of content creation. After graduating from Full Sail University, Tim began his career as an animation artist and, over two decades, expanded into more highly technical developer roles at leading game and production studios. He worked at Sony Picture Imageworks, Two Bit Circus, Gameloft, and GameHouse to name a few. Aside from helping produce countless games, movies, and XR experiences, Tim has used his deep knowledge of technology and entertainment paradigms to make novel solutions to scale content creation with interoperable files for transmedia.

content.rendered: Tuğçe Joy majored in Psychology and then completed her masters in Cognitive Science, where she combined Psychology with Computer Engineering. She started working with Virtual and Augmented Reality as a lab assistant in 2015. Then she joined a startup and worked as a UX researcher for more than 2 years. She took part in many XR projects with different institutions and companies including but not limited to MIT Media Lab and Facebook Reality Labs. She published research papers in prestigious journals and conferences such as Virtual Reality Journal and CHI. Currently, she is working as a research assistant at Harvard University’s Learning, Innovation and Technology lab exploring the use of new immersive technologies in education.

Ready Player Golf raised over $12k for Médicines Sans Frontieres, Doctors Without Borders in the first of its kind, Virtual Reality Charity Golf Outing, held on September 25, 2020. John Rhys Davies was our celebrity ambassador. The Awards show held the next day in ENGAGE treated all the participants to an immersive experience with 3D animations with the them of the history of golf.

Created by Richard Ward and co-organized by Sophia Moshasha and Ben Erwin this show broke new ground in the VR world by creating a fun experience that inspired charitable giving and made real world impact.

content.rendered: The WebXR Developer Summit Hosted by Trevor Flowers was the first event of the WebXR Summit Series. It was inspired by acceptance speeches from The 1st Polys – WebXR Awards and was held on May 25, 2021, convening pioneers and leaders in WebXR and the XR Industry. It’s focus on coding for WebXR enlightened many to the possibilities and methods of delivering of XR content delivered to browsers. This event inspired the WebXR Summits that followed it and stands as a milestone in bringing awareness of the possibilities of WebXR to the Community.

content.rendered:
Thank you for participating in the WebXR Business Summit hosted by Samantha Mathews on September 14, 2021

Stay tuned for the launch of the individual videos, coming soon.

The summit featured WebXR business leaders and pioneers sharing their knowledge of and experience with immersive technologies, which are already producing ROI through work efficiencies, improved performances, and a sustainable global footprint. 

Perspectives include WebXR success stories, lessons learned, persona alignment, communication, and collaboration to ensure successful business outcomes.  

Galaxy Sponsor

We encourage you to join the community by coming to the watch parties hosted on SEVEN different platforms for this event! Thank you to all the people that helped make this possible.

The WebXR Design Summit was hosted by Kent Bye on October 12, 2021. It introduces applications of spatial computing to interactive storytelling and the user design experience. 


The world’s WebXR experts, 3D designers, and marketers share design principles and best practices for immersive technologies. In order to reap the benefits of WebXR, professionals need to know how to create content for the medium, and the Design Summit will show the way. 


Spatial design is still new. Attendees at the summit will learn key tools, design considerations for 3D, and spatial thinking. Attendees will hear about WebXR success stories, common pitfalls to avoid, and design tips

title.rendered: PaaS, SaaS, and Native Browser Support

content.rendered: These business models for delivering WebXR solutions to customers each have a different cost-benefit analysis. This is an explanation for decision makers on how to navigate the ecosystem by choosing what makes the most sense for them based on their use cases.

excerpt.rendered: Racing to market with a lack of standards has created fragmentation as innovators that have built business models that lock customers into proprietary solutions. Adapting to and supporting standards is the key to survival.

Dear [NAME],

meta.event_invite_instructions:
Karen Alexander and Daniel Dyboski-Bryant are looking forward to welcoming you to our Green Room at
[GREEN_ROOM_URL]
at [GREEN_ROOM_TIME] PDT to test your mic and camera, and ability to screen share if applicable.
 
The session will begin promptly at [START_TIME] Pacific Daylight Time (UTC-7) and ends at [END_TIME] PDT
Please accept this calendar invite to confirm your engagement.
 
If possible, please use a 1080p webcam and sit in a well-lit and quiet area. We will be using the Restream platform, which supports virtual backgrounds. Please be advised that this may cause undesired blurring effects when you move. Real world backgrounds are preferred. You are welcome to use a custom 1920x1080 jpg or png image file as your background. it also has a blur feature similar to Zoom
 
For sound, we would prefer that you not wear a headset for aesthetic reasons, unless you are in a location with unavoidable background noise or sound check reveals an echo.
 
We are excited for you to share your expertise with our global audience.
If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at webxrevents@gmail.com
 
See you on September 15th!
Your friends,
The Polys – WebXR Awards and WebXR Summit Series Team

content.rendered:
The Poly for Lifetime Achivement honors individuals who have made invaluable contributions to the WebXR Stack.

We are honoring Brandon Jones for his work in bringing excellence in 3D Graphics to the Web through WebVR, WebXR and WebGPU. Thank you Brandon for everything you have done to help accelerate this medium for web developers to deliver immersive experiences through browsers.

content.rendered:
The Ombudsperson Award honors achievement in promoting public awareness of philosophical, ethical and human rights issue in XR.

As a veteran engineer and pioneer in XR, Avi Bar-Zeev has consistently presented thoughtful reflections on the impact of advanced technologies. Thank you Avi for expanding our perspective to keep these tools in service of humanity, without becoming a cookbook.

content.rendered: XR technologies are powerful tools with enormous potential to transform education. Yet these technologies also come with considerable risks. This panel will explore delve into philosophical and ethical issues surrounding the use of XR with young people and will address ways to ensure safety, privacy, and human dignity.

content.rendered: Medical training is one of the most important use cases in XR, because it gives students and healthcare professionals immersive access to realistic healthcare scenarios, without posing risks to live patients, and without requiring the extensive resources needed for re-enactment in a live clinical training setting on a per learner basis. From operating medical machines to understanding patient perspectives, immersive learning programs are more effective and economical than traditional 2D modalities. Hear from leading experts in immersive medical education.

content.rendered: Sophia Moshasha has a conversation with Igalia founders Juan José Sánchez Penas and Sergio Villar Senin to tell the story of how the Wolvic Browser came to be. Mozilla discontinued development of the open-source Firefox® Reality browser in 2020 leaving the community of WebXR developers without a hardware-independent browser. Then Igalia stepped-in, resurrecting and modernizing the code base, and recently released Wolvic! See what opportunities and plans lie ahead for the only Immersive-Only browser in XR.

title.rendered: The Importance of WebXR and the Immersive Web

content.rendered: Wolvic is the only browser that runs on multiple VR platforms which is a very significant advancement for the immersive web ecosystem. Polys creator Ben Erwin welcomes a panel of diverse expertise for a discussion on developing, deploying, scaling, and building community around this unique open-source initiative to provide alternatives to manufacturers, developers and consumers for distributed WebXR experiences.

@graph.description: Honoring and Inspiring the Pioneers of WebXR

content.rendered:
Patrick Cozzi was honored on March 5, 2023 on the LED Volume at ZeroSpace in Brooklyn, New York for his work in developing the gtTF Specification. This award was both the first time a Poly was presented in- person, and presented in a Looking Glass Holographic display.

The award was presented by Shawn Frayne, CEO and Co-Founder of Looking Glass, along with a video where prior honoree, Brandon Jones who selected Patrick as his successor honored his work. This was followed by love from the community by Patrick’s friends and colleagues Neil Trevett, Nadine Alameh, Damon Hernandez, and Tony Parisi.

excerpt.rendered: Awarded to Patrick Cozzi at The 3rd Polys WebXR Awards on March 5, 2023

The Polys - WebXR Awards

items.title: WebXR Business Summit
items.content:
Thank you for participating in the WebXR Business Summit hosted by Samantha Mathews on September 14, 2021

Stay tuned for the launch of the individual videos, coming soon.

The summit featured WebXR business leaders and pioneers sharing their knowledge of and experience with immersive technologies, which are already producing ROI through work efficiencies, improved performances, and a sustainable global footprint. 

Perspectives include WebXR success stories, lessons learned, persona alignment, communication, and collaboration to ensure successful business outcomes.  

Galaxy Sponsor

We encourage you to join the community by coming to the watch parties hosted on SEVEN different platforms for this event! Thank you to all the people that helped make this possible.

items.title: Samantha Mathews
items.content:
Samantha Mathews is Founder & CEO; CTO of LOCI, a patented and neurologically proven safety training platform that transforms unstructured location and occupancy data into digital components that power a game engine that generates gamified content based on your environment. LOCI teaches people where to go and what to do to stay safe in places they visit and spend time regardless of age, language, or ability.

To Samantha, technology has always been a tool for connecting with people and improving lives. She builds by her belief that, instead of deepening our dependence on technology and letting it do the thinking for us, new systems should empower us to be more present, knowledgeable, and confident wherever we go.

items.title: Samantha Mathews
items.content:
Samantha Mathews is Founder & CEO; CTO of LOCI, a patented and neurologically proven safety training platform that transforms unstructured location and occupancy data into digital components that power a game engine that generates gamified content based on your environment.
